title: 自实现 __enter__/__exit__ 与异常吞噬
expected_output:
正常退出:
打开 A
使用 A
关闭 A (异常=无)

只吞 ValueError:
打开 B
关闭 B (异常=ValueError)
  -> __exit__ 返回 True，异常被吞掉
  with 之后继续执行 -> 到达此行

KeyError 未被吞，正常向外抛: 'k'
打开 C
关闭 C (异常=KeyError)

要点: __exit__ 返回 True = 吞异常; 返回 None/False = 继续传播
code:
class Resource:
    def __init__(self, name, swallow=None, log=None):
        self.name = name
        self.swallow = swallow
        self.log = log

    def __enter__(self):
        self.log.append("打开 " + self.name)
        return self

    def __exit__(self, et, ev, tb):
        tag = et.__name__ if et else "无"
        self.log.append("关闭 " + self.name + " (异常=" + tag + ")")
        if self.swallow is not None and et is self.swallow:
            self.log.append("  -> __exit__ 返回 True，异常被吞掉")
            return True
        return False


log1 = []
with Resource("A", log=log1) as r:
    log1.append("使用 " + r.name)
print("正常退出:")
print("\n".join(log1))
print()

log2 = []
with Resource("B", swallow=ValueError, log=log2):
    raise ValueError("业务校验失败")
print("只吞 ValueError:")
print("\n".join(log2))
print("  with 之后继续执行 -> 到达此行")
print()

log3 = []
try:
    with Resource("C", swallow=ValueError, log=log3):
        raise KeyError("k")
except KeyError as e:
    print("KeyError 未被吞，正常向外抛:", e)
print("\n".join(log3))
print()
print("要点: __exit__ 返回 True = 吞异常; 返回 None/False = 继续传播")
